# Set-ZbxDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a dashboard.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxDashboard [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDashboard>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Private <bool>] [-User <ZabbixDashboardUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixDashboardUserGroupRequest[]>] [-DisplayPeriod <int>] [-AutoStart <bool>] [-Page <ZabbixDashboardUpdatePageRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A dashboard is a page of widgets in the Zabbix frontend, such as graphs, problem lists and maps, shared with users and user groups. The Set-ZbxDashboard cmdlet changes the dashboards given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with dashboard.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every dashboard the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed dashboards back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a dashboard

```powershell
Set-ZbxDashboard -InputObject 'Ops overview' -DisplayPeriod 60
```

Makes the dashboard Ops overview show each of its pages for 60 seconds in slide show mode.

### Example 2: Change a dashboard and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxDashboard -InputObject 'Ops overview' -DisplayPeriod 60 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the dashboard Ops overview back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixDashboard>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ulong`: Bound to -UserId (ByPropertyName).
- `bool`: Bound to -Private (ByPropertyName), -AutoStart (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixDashboardUserRequest[]`: Bound to -User (ByPropertyName). users of a ZabbixDashboardCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixDashboardUserGroupRequest[]`: Bound to -UserGroup (ByPropertyName). userGroups of a ZabbixDashboardCreateRequest.
- `int`: Bound to -DisplayPeriod (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `ZabbixDashboardUpdatePageRequest[]`: Bound to -Page (ByPropertyName). pages of a ZabbixDashboardUpdateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixDashboard`: Dashboard class.
